title: 真实Git自定义三方合并驱动：文本可合并也须拒绝跨服务端口碰撞
body:
## 操作任务
实现merge(base_path,ours_path,theirs_path)，供实际Git merge driver的%O/%A/%B调用，成功True覆盖ours，冲突False且ours原字节不变。JSON必须仅含services字典，非空服务名→非bool整数端口1..65535，各输入端口不得重复，重复JSON键/非法JSON/额外root字段拒绝。按服务名做三方合并：ours=theirs采用；ours=base采用theirs；theirs=base采用ours；两侧对同键不同更改（含删除对修改）冲突。缺键不同于值；合并后还必须验证全局端口唯一，否则拒绝，即使每侧各自有效且文本改动分离。成功输出UTF8合法JSON。平台在五个临时真实仓库配置driver，检查Git确实调用、成功merge双父，失败HEAD不进且index冲突stage保留；不修改用户/系统Git配置。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git merge/gitattributes/外部driver，只操作自建临时仓库，没有OpsForge实际Git历史操作、远程推送或默认身份变化。封闭的平面services→port教学schema，不是任意JSON语义合并、部署端口可用性或生产配置兼容证明；Git退出0和合法JSON本身不能代替业务不变量检查。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

conversion.original_title: 为结构化配置引入Git自定义merge driver时，怎样交付语义冲突不会被退出0掩盖的验收？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现merge(base_path,ours_path,theirs_path)，供实际Git merge driver的%O/%A/%B调用，成功True覆盖ours，冲突False且ours原字节不变。JSON必须仅含services字典，非空服务名→非bool整数端口1..65535，各输入端口不得重复，重复JSON键/非法JSON/额外root字段拒绝。按服务名做三方合并：ours=theirs采用；ours=base采用theirs；theirs=base采用ours；两侧对同键不同更改（含删除对修改）冲突。缺键不同于值；合并后还必须验证全局端口唯一，否则拒绝，即使每侧各自有效且文本改动分离。成功输出UTF8合法JSON。平台在五个临时真实仓库配置driver，检查Git确实调用、成功merge双父，失败HEAD不进且index冲突stage保留；不修改用户/系统Git配置。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实Git merge/gitattributes/外部driver，只操作自建临时仓库，没有OpsForge实际Git历史操作、远程推送或默认身份变化。封闭的平面services→port教学schema，不是任意JSON语义合并、部署端口可用性或生产配置兼容证明；Git退出0和合法JSON本身不能代替业务不变量检查。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,tempfile,pathlib,json,subprocess,shlex,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','maintenance.auto=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
base={'api':8000,'worker':9000}
cases=[({'api':8100,'worker':9000},{'api':8000,'worker':9100},{'api':8100,'worker':9100}),({'api':8100,'worker':9000},{'api':8200,'worker':9000},None),({'api':9001,'worker':9000},{'api':8000,'worker':9001},None),({'worker':9000},{'api':8100,'worker':9000},None),({'api':8000,'worker':9000,'audit':10000},{'api':8000,'worker':9000,'batch':10000},None)]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-semantic-merge-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);driver=root/'merge driver.py'
 driver.write_text('import os,sys\nsys.path.insert(0,'+repr(str(pathlib.Path(task.__file__).parent))+')\nimport task\nwith open(os.environ["OPSF_DRIVER_LOG"],"a") as out:out.write("called\\n")\nraise SystemExit(0 if task.merge(*sys.argv[1:]) else 1)\n')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_git_custom_driver_semantic_three_way_merge',flush=True)
 for index,(ours,theirs,expected) in enumerate(cases):
  repo=root/('repo'+str(index));repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main');name='config with spaces.json';path=repo/name
  (repo/'.gitattributes').write_text('"config with spaces.json" merge=jsonports\n')
  driver_command=shlex.quote(sys.executable)+' -B '+shlex.quote(str(driver))+' "%O" "%A" "%B"'
  git(repo,'config','merge.jsonports.driver',driver_command)
  def commit(values,message):
   path.write_text(json.dumps({'services':values},sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n');git(repo,'add','.');git(repo,'commit','-m',message);return git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip()
  ancestor=commit(base,'fixture ancestor');ours_oid=commit(ours,'fixture ours');ours_bytes=path.read_bytes()
  git(repo,'checkout','-b','theirs',ancestor);theirs_oid=commit(theirs,'fixture theirs');git(repo,'checkout','main')
  config=(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes();driver_log=root/('driver-'+str(index)+'.log');env['OPSF_DRIVER_LOG']=str(driver_log)
  merged=git(repo,'merge','--no-ff','--no-edit',theirs_oid,ok=False)
  assert driver_log.exists() and 'called' in driver_log.read_text(),'Git custom driver was not actually invoked'
  if expected is not None:
   assert merged.returncode==0,merged.stderr
   assert json.loads(path.read_bytes())=={'services':expected}
   assert git(repo,'rev-list','--parents','-n','1','HEAD').stdout.split()[1:]==[ours_oid,theirs_oid]
   assert git(repo,'ls-files','-u','--',name).stdout==''
  else:
   assert merged.returncode!=0,'driver exit0 hid text/semantic merge conflict'
   assert git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip()==ours_oid and git(repo,'ls-files','-u','--',name).stdout,'Git did not preserve unresolved conflict stages'
   assert path.read_bytes()==ours_bytes,'rejected semantic merge partially rewrote ours'
  assert (repo/'.git/config').read_bytes()==config
  assert json.loads(git(repo,'show',ancestor+':'+name).stdout)=={'services':base}
  assert json.loads(git(repo,'show',theirs_oid+':'+name).stdout)=={'services':theirs}
 # Direct boundary files validate duplicate JSON keys/types without touching Git or partial output.
 a=root/'base.json';o=root/'ours.json';t=root/'theirs.json'
 normal=json.dumps({'services':base});a.write_text(normal);o.write_text(normal);t.write_text(normal)
 assert task.merge(a,o,t) is True and json.loads(o.read_text())=={'services':base}
 for invalid in ['{"services":{"api":8000,"api":8100}}','{"services":{"api":true}}','{"services":{"api":0}}','{"services":{},"unexpected":1}','not-json']:
  o.write_text(normal);t.write_text(invalid);before=o.read_bytes()
  assert task.merge(a,o,t) is False and o.read_bytes()==before,'invalid candidate accepted or ours lost'
 print('NATIVE_GIT_DRIVER_SAME_KEY_DELETE_MODIFY_AND_CROSS_KEY_PORT_COLLISIONS_STAY_UNMERGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
